summary: Iter 92.47 sidebar Upgrade CTA fix verified across free, standard, and accelerator tiers, plus expanded + collapsed variants.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is clean and correct: uses ternary `tier === 'free' ? '...' : '...'` guaranteeing string label, eliminating the empty-label bug when tier is undefined/unknown.
Minor: `title` attr uses 'Leadership OS aktivieren' whereas visible label is 'Leadership OS holen' — slight copy divergence but not a bug.
Icon-tile only rendered in expanded variant (as intended); collapsed uses bare Crown centered in 36×36 gradient tile.
test_credentials: free@wladbot.test / test123, standard@wladbot.test / test123, accelerator@wladbot.test / test123 (all working)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 92.47 sidebar Upgrade CTA verified end-to-end via /api/auth/login (token) + localStorage injection at wladbot_token. data-testid='sidebar-upgrade-btn' + data-testid='sidebar-collapse-btn' work reliably. Lint clean on SidebarFooter.js.
rca of the issue: Original bug used `{tier === 'free' && 'Leadership OS holen'} {tier === 'standard' && 'upgrade'}` which returned false for any other tier value, yielding empty label with full-width lime styling. Fix replaces with guaranteed-string ternary + adds icon-tile wrapper + arrow chevron + hover:scale + collapsed 36×36 variant. All tier states now render correctly.
